nativeTrueGLPixelA_B.rootCauseReevaluation: The weak impact R21 identified is not only due to BSDF values: changing private research shader materially affects some existing visible facades at 65.25 but does not make largely invisible ship, gantry, foam visible; selective water ID branch adds no RGB10 or RGB25 differences across three sampled original source frames.

criticalART.positive: Real original source shader branches A/B work without gameplay changes; R21 authentic material bridge byte-identical, tests became faster without new Blender/mesh; original game, HUD, moving hazard and road still rendered.
criticalART.negative: Mode1 over-brightens a broad left industrial roof at first time, worsening dominance rather than giving harbor industrial credibility; missing working ship, dock, gantry, foam in source chase remains. Mode2 maritime water special branch has no meaningful visible effect above RGB10 at all times. No increase in genuine ecological water/coast/industrial narrative or human-authored landmark quality.
criticalART.learning: Stop expanding material name lists, hidden meshes, and shader toggles merely to increase pixels. The next independent improvement must target true camera-facing *architecture and meaningful world geometry*, with continuous source chase plus source hazard visibility and an independent critical art gate before full QA.
